text_block_list.text:
One day, while we were devising our strategy
for the Mile CS.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer!
It's Taiki-san! Taiki-san is on TV!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle, who has been making a name for herself in recent years,
continues to see her abilities grow with no bounds.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The one driving her forward was,
after all, that very Umamusume—!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yes, down with Hishi Akebono!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"I trained suuuper hard for the Sprinters Stakes the other day,
determined to win no matter what, yes!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Training every single day, from morning to night!
Running alongside all kinds of friends—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I held back on food and snacks to tone up!
I was super muscular!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Still, I couldn't win!
Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"That is why right now, I am veeery frustrated, but having so much fun!
Next time, I will definitely not lose!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: "HAAAAAAAAHHH!!"

Even through the screen, it was obvious.
Taiki Shuttle was even stronger and faster
than she had been at the recent Sprinters Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Let's win!
No sooner had she said that than I was hoisted up once again and we took off running. As expected, our destination was—
It was that kitchen.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: My strength is being big!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: So she's got power, and she doesn't mind taking wide lines or getting boxed in, right~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Then if I get way, way bigger and super buff,
I'll get waaaay stronger, right?!

Maintaining the status quo is one thing, but if she gets any bigger,
will the strain on her legs really be manageable?

A slight sense of unease crosses my mind.
—However.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
...You know what? Next time, I wanna get way stronger, way bigger,
so I can definitely beat Taiki-san!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I've decided to run a race true to myself.
If I'm gonna do it, I'm going all the way!

Indeed, this was decided after careful discussion.
The time for hesitation is over.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
Thank you, Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
All right! Now that that's settled...
For lunch, let's have crystal chicken and broccoli salad~!

Hishi Akebono began cooking right away.
She set a pot of water on the stove and skillfully sliced the chicken breast on an angle.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Poke some holes in the meat with a fork, then rub in plenty of salt and sake~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Once it's rubbed in, let it sit for just a bit.
Maybe I'll whip up the sauce while we wait~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Today we need soy sauce, sugar, vinegar, sesame oil, and...
Time to chop up some green onions~!

While mixing the sauce, chopping the cucumbers to lay underneath,
and slicing the broccoli, the water comes to a boil.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ah, gotta dust it with potato starch~!
Thinly, nice and thin...! Yup, that should do it!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Drop the meat into boiling water and cook it through~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
It's dangerous if it's not cooked through, but overcooking
makes the meat tough~. It's so tricky.
Afterward, the cooked meat was scooped upand chilled in ice-cold water to firm it up.

"Once it cools down, drain the excess water,
and in the meantime prep the broccoli salad, and before you know it—"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
All done!
A mountain-sized serving of crystal chicken and broccoli salad~☆

An absolutely staggering amount of lunch
was slammed down onto the table...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
All right!
Let's eat, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
And with that, let's win!
With my running—with our running!

The crystal chicken and broccoli were as exquisite as ever,
and the two of them ate enthusiastically—
Before I realized it, the plate was completely empty.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Stuffed full.
Thanks for the food~♪

Now that our stomachs are satisfied,
we must quickly draw up our future plans.

I took out my training book
and began checking for effective exercises to build muscle, when—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: No. It's just, well, something feels off.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Feels like there's nothing the two of us can't do!
From that day on, she continued to tackle demanding daily training sessions in pursuit of victory.

One day, as the Mile Championship drew near,
we were scheduled to be interviewed.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"My rival is, well...
Taiki Shuttle-san~☆"

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Really!?
That's truly a showdown between fated rivals!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. I'm working super hard right now
so I can give it my all against Taiki-san~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I've been working out a ton, too,
and I've gotten super ripped, you know!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Look~!

With those words from Hishi Akebono,
my feet suddenly lifted off the ground.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe!
Heave-ho~.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Ohh! Amazing...
Lifting Trainer with one hand so effortlessly...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"And indeed, you've gotten a whole size bigger
since the Sprinters Stakes!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, right, right?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I'll deliver even more thrilling races,
so look forward to it, okay~♪

This first declaration of war coming from Hishi Akebono
instantly became a hot topic.
